home.hero_subtitle: Jokkondira e kaayitaaji SIM maa ngam heɓde ID dijital kisal, keeriiɗo, hoolkisaaɗo e nder hojomaaji seeɗa.
home.feature_1_desc: Dowlaaji maa keertiiɗi ina keddii e lowre ndee. Min kuutortoo tan ko maandeeji hoolaare booleeje.
home.feature_2_desc: Ɓeydu tolno hoolaare maa e jokkondirde haa karte SIM 3 ummoriiɗe e kala lowre Afrik.
home.feature_3_desc: Bankeeji, kilinikuuji, e pelle ɗe ngonaa laamuyankooje ina mbaawi hoolkisaade VID maa ɗoon e ɗoon e kode QR.

enroll.title: Winndito e VID
enroll.subtitle: Jokku e lowre anndinde dijital kisal.
enroll.has_id_question: Mbele aɗa jogii mbaadi anndinde gonndi?
enroll.has_id_description: Kaayitaaji ngenndiiji, paaspoor, walla kaayitaaji diwooje. Ɓeydude ɗum ina semmbina tolno hoolaare maa.
enroll.phone_error_invalid: Naatnu limoore wondude e kod leydi yeru +2348031234567
enroll.consent_text: So a ƴeewtindiima kaɓirgol les ngol, miɗo rokka VID yamiroore laaɓnde ngam ɗaɓɓude maandeeji reso (stabilite SIM, match KYC, e nokku) e gollotooɓe e reso portaabe ngam hoolkisaade ko ngon-mi koo.
enroll.consent_privacy: Miɗo faami wonde hay dokke neɗɗo gooto mooftaaka e serweeji VID.
enroll.consent_agree: Mi jaɓii kadi mi rokkii yamiroore am
enroll.location_description: Hoolkiso nokku maa tigi-rigi ngam ɓeydude tolno hoolaare VID maa.
enroll.loader_description: Emin hoolkisa darnde SIM maa, jokkondire KYC, e nokku maa e gollorɗe diiwaan.
enroll.loader_timing: Ngolɗoo laawol heewi ƴettude ko leƴƴanɗe 15-20 ngam jokkondire kisal.

verification.title: Anndinde hoolkiso
verification.subtitle: ID Reso Pan-Afrik goonga
